all_candidates.topic: Should banks be allowed to charge for UPI transactions?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Lok Sabha passed a bill on August 6, 2026, which received presidential assent on August 17, 2026, authorizing the government to permit banks to levy charges on specified UPI transactions.

all_candidates.topic: Should mid-day meal programs have stricter quality checks?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Many students were hospitalized on August 19, 2026, after a cook accidentally added detergent instead of salt to a Bihar mid-day meal.

all_candidates.topic: Are large-scale tech layoffs in India justified for efficiency?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Reports on August 11-13, 2026, indicated Oracle cut around 12,000 roles in India, with more planned, as part of a significant workforce reduction.

all_candidates.topic: Should Delhi's aggressive EV mandates be adopted nationwide?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Delhi government approved EV Policy 2.0 on August 19, 2026, setting ambitious targets and phaseout mandates for internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles.

all_candidates.topic: Should fire safety regulations for hotels be stricter nationwide?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A fire in a Kolkata building housing several hotels on August 19, 2026, killed 9 and injured 6.

all_candidates.topic: Will new four-tier NTA exam security prevent leaks?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Education Ministry announced new four-tier checking system measures on August 18, 2026, to prevent question paper leaks in NTA examinations.

all_candidates.topic: Will removing NTA staff improve exam integrity?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Education Minister directed NTA to overhaul its exam system on August 17, 2026, with over 50 staff members removed.

all_candidates.topic: Is AI creating enough quality jobs to offset Indian layoffs?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A Nomura report, reported on August 8, 2026, indicated India saw 2.6 AI-related hires for every job lost to AI, with a catch about job type.

all_candidates.topic: Should FSSAI mandate front-of-pack warning labels on packaged food?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Supreme Court on August 13, 2026, criticized the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) for not introducing front-of-pack warning labels on packaged food products.

all_candidates.topic: Should public protests against exam irregularities be protected?
all_candidates.news_anchor: AISA president Neha Bora faced an ink attack on August 7, 2026, during a protest against recruitment exam irregularities in Jharkhand.

all_candidates.topic: Should FSSAI strictly limit school food fat/sugar/salt?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) published a draft amendment on August 10, 2026, proposing exact limits for fat, sugar, and salt in school foods.

all_candidates.topic: Was Delhi's initial R3 language exam policy too strict?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Delhi government withdrew its order on August 18, 2026, which had barred Class 10 students from board exams for failing a third-language paper.

all_candidates.topic: Should credit card reward structures be better regulated?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Indian banking institutions began restructuring credit card reward policies, fees, and service charges from August 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is India's new DPDP Act truly effective for citizen data privacy?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act) is in active implementation, with Phase 2 (Consent Manager framework) taking effect in November 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is India's current EV charging infrastructure sufficient for growth?
all_candidates.news_anchor: As of August 7, 2026, India had installed 67,657 electric vehicle chargers, according to a Ministry of Heavy Industries report on August 18, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Are FSSAI's perpetual licenses good for food safety?
all_candidates.news_anchor: FSSAI introduced amendments on July 27, 2026, which grant perpetual validity to licenses and registrations for food businesses.

all_candidates.topic: Will new RBI data governance rules protect bank customer privacy?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) recently issued 'Guidance on Regulatory Expectations for Data Governance' for banks on August 18, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Will the Industrial Housing Scheme effectively address urban worker needs?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Union Budget 2026-27, highlighted on August 14, 2026, introduced a new Scheme for Industrial Housing.

all_candidates.topic: Will decriminalizing minor offenses truly boost ease of doing business?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Act, 2026, which decriminalizes 717 provisions, was highlighted on August 13, 2026, as a significant reform.

all_candidates.topic: Should government procurement platforms expand access for small businesses?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Government e-Marketplace (GeM) facilitated over ₹20 lakh crore+ in procurement as on August 6, 2026, expanding market access for diverse businesses.
